QuestionStmt.S: Identify the product 'B' in following reaction. Ethanal $\xrightarrow{\text{dil. NaOH}}$ A $\xrightarrow[\text{H}_2\text{O}]{\Delta}$ B

Solution.S: Ethanal (acetaldehyde) undergoes aldol addition with dilute NaOH to form 3-hydroxybutanal (A). On heating with dilute H₂O (which provides the medium), the aldol undergoes dehydration to form but-2-enal (crotonaldehyde). Thus product B is but-2-enal, which corresponds to option C.
